$schema: Plan schema for session checkpoint-based planning (v2)

checkpoints.title: Graph query parity
checkpoints.goal: Expose computed evidence through complete graph-backed worker surfaces.

verification_steps: Run focused graph query and tool wrapper tests

task_groups.title: Related evidence queries
task_groups.objective: Add file-card relationships, structured related-function lookup, and all-source graph search.

task_groups.title: Ghidra ingestion
task_groups.objective: Convert exported xrefs into provenance-preserving graph records and surface corroboration.

checkpoints.title: Toolkit pruning
checkpoints.goal: Remove dead and duplicate surfaces while retaining active generators and capabilities.

verification_steps: Run tool resolver, prompt, registry, and smoke tests

task_groups.title: Dead assets
task_groups.objective: Remove recipes, sweep helpers, deprecated corpora, stale registrations, and dead facades.

task_groups.title: Duplicate APIs
task_groups.objective: Remove direct lookup surfaces only where graph parity is verified.

checkpoints.title: Documentation and verification
checkpoints.goal: Align implementation docs with the graph-first design and verify the integrated cleanup.

verification_steps: Run relevant Bun and Python suites

task_groups.title: Docs maintenance
task_groups.objective: Rewrite drifted knowledge implementation documentation as present-state architecture.

task_groups.title: Integrated verification
task_groups.objective: Resolve regressions and confirm deleted surfaces have no live consumers.
